diagnostic.name: goal-native-stages-02

protocol.name: goal-native-stages-02
protocol.scope: Focused 120-second warmup and 120-second stable control; not full capacity acceptance

host.note: Read-only process CPU counters; overlapping whole-window samples only; not CPU-frequency or thermal control.

process_affinity.scope: Owned child process immediately after launch; other processes unchanged

diagnostic.cpu_observation_note: Total per-core load including the benchmark; affinity restricts this process but does not reserve CPUs against other processes.

phases.weighting: All forced edit samples weight 1; ordinary samples share remaining stable population equally.
phases.caveat: Whole timed scopes include serial snapshots, guards and callbacks. Models are bounds/sensitivity estimates, not measured worker speedups. Sampled tails have limited resolution.

timing_scope_notes: C timers run on every invocation; the helper copies counters on its sampled ticks. Observer overhead is included.
Total contains the root scopes; sparse solve contains factorization, triangular solve and permutation validation.
Permutation validation may also be inside factorization. Do not sum all inclusive stages.
body_other subtracts disjoint root scopes; sparse_other_including_permutation subtracts only factorization and triangular solve.
JNI includes profile setup and timing overhead outside the measured solver body. Tiny clock-boundary differences are retained.
Weights retain every forced edit with weight one; ordinary samples share the remaining stable tick population.
limitations: The compiler and native library differ from the retained runtime. These timings locate work; they are not evidence of a speedup.
No new client load or full acceptance is established by this diagnostic.
Focused fixtures and this copied-yard run do not establish all mod functionality.
